thread:
Devin: Quick intake — Nebula-30B showed up in the model-shelf; want to decide if we prioritize onboarding this sprint. TL;DR: promising quality, some quant sensitivity.

Anya: Can we run a fast scoring pass against our onboarding criteria (product fit, latency, cost, quant-risk, eval regressions)?

Kai: I ran a 1k-sample smoke perf on g4dn-8x (single-worker) — baseline ppl 15.2, p95 single-token (after KV warm) ~480ms at seq=2048. Memory looks ok with 24GB reserved.

Samir: Quick quant note: per-layer sensitivity spikes around layers 22-24 on per-channel int8; naive 8-bit yields +3% hallucination on our TruthfulQA slice. FP16 and q4f16 look fine.

Rachel: Product context — this model maps well to convo summarization and customer-facing helpers (higher coherency). Enterprise demand: medium (one inbound AE request).

Anya: Here's a lightweight scorecard I put together — feel free to adjust.
```
Criteria (0-5):
Product fit: 4
Latency (hosted target): 3
Cost delta vs baseline: 2
Quantization risk: 3
Eval regressions (quality drop vs incumbent): 2
Total: 14 / 30
```

Kai: 14/30 sounds low-moderate. Suggest a canary onboarding: run full eval suite + targeted quant experiments, but gate full production on q4f16 or per-channel int8 with per-layer fallback.

Devin: Roadmap note — infra team is landing improved 8-bit kernels next sprint (Q2) which would reduce quant-risk. Given that and product fit, my call: priority=P2 (schedule in next intake slot).

Devin: @ops-bot can you create an onboarding ticket and assign to eng-ml bench?

ops-bot: Ticket created: RED-12345 — Nebula-30B onboarding (https://redwood.example/RED-12345) assigned to Kai, Samir.

Kai: I'll run the full eval pass this afternoon (safety+, TruthfulQA, summarization BLEU/ROUGE, latency profiles). Sharing the eval command I used for the smoke run: 
```bash
python eval.py --model nebula-30b --dataset quick-smoke --seq-len 2048 --bs 1 --save-metrics /tmp/nebula-smoke.json
```

Samir: Need a fused-attn build from branch fused/gemm-opt for the best latency numbers. I'll validate and merge by EOD.

Rachel: Optional: we can reduce default max context to 1024 for hosted POC to save cost while we validate.

Anya: Blockers: (1) quant baseline uncertainty (Samir working), (2) full eval runtime (Kai running), (3) legal data-check (I will ping compliance).

Devin: Summary: P2 onboarding, create ticket (done), run evals + quant experiments, gate prod on acceptable quant profile or fallback to fp16 with autoscale. Schedule bench slot next Tue. @Samir @Kai — update the ticket with results. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: RED-12345 updated: label=onboarding_in_progress, due=1990070000

Kai: Posted initial eval artifacts here: https://s3.redwood/nebula/artifacts/1990012345 — will add full metrics when done.

Samir: Merged fused/gemm-opt -> main in staging, starting perf runs now.

Rachel: Thanks team — sounds good. :party-parrot:
